defects_argued.quote: Consequently, the Petitioner was unable to file a reply to the impugned Show Cause Notice or appear before the Adjudicating Authority for personal hearing, resulting in the impugned ex parte order.

As observed by this Court, that the challenge to the above mentioned notifications is presently under consideration before the Supreme Court in S.L.P No 4240/2025 titled M/s HCC-SEW-MEIL- AAG JV v. Assistant Commissioner of State Tax &Ors., the challenge made by the Petitioner to the impugned notifications in the present proceedings shall also be subject to the outcome of the decision of the Supreme Court.

outcome.quote: Accordingly, the impugned order is set aside, subject to payment of Rs.20,000/- as costs to the Delhi High Court Bar Association.
